name: EES: an earlier exit is not called a missing entry

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2024-06-14&fresh=1 (pins today and clears saved trips)
Click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add), enter entry 2024-06-01 (data-testid=trip-entry) and exit 2024-06-10 (data-testid=trip-exit), and click save (data-testid=trip-save)
Enter 8 in the EES days used field (data-testid=ees-days-used), enter '2024-06-01 2024-06-08' in the EES records field (data-testid=ees-records), and click compare (data-testid=ees-compare)
The findings list (data-testid=ees-codes) has data-codes exactly 'figure-differs exit-dates-disagree'
The explanation (data-testid=ees-explanation) does not contain 'Likely missing entry'
